description: 1. For each feature branch, the agent must use `git rebase -i HEAD~3` to squash the 3 messy commits into 1 clean commit (or at most 2). This requires knowing the interactive rebase syntax from SKILL.md. 2. Each squashed feature branch must then be merged into `main` using `git merge --no-ff feature/payment-validation` and `git merge --no-ff feature/ledger-export` — the `--no-ff` flag is critical; a plain fast-forward merge will fail the topology check. 3. The agent must create an annotated tag with `git tag -a v1.0.0 -m 'Release version 1.0.0'` — a lightweight `git tag v1.0.0` will fail the annotated-type check since the eval uses `git cat-file -t v1.0.0` to verify the object type is 'tag' not 'commit'. 4. The agent must identify the specific security commit on `hotfix/input-sanitization` (via `git log hotfix/input-sanitization` or reading `.security_commit_hash`) and use `git cherry-pick <hash>` to apply it onto `main`. The eval verifies that `main`'s `transaction.py` contains the `isinstance` type guard AND that the commit introducing it on `main` has a different hash than the original hotfix commit.
